title: Complete XRAY method coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix Xray JSON generation, inbound/outbound wiring, atomic config replacement, lifecycle, and secret redaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated Xray config is valid JSON and passes schema/structural assertions for supported protocols
Config replacement is atomic and does not leave a partially written file visible to a starting process
Start/stop/restart/reconnect/cleanup and invalid-binary/config cases have focused tests
Credentials are absent from logs, events, diagnostics, and API responses

steps.details: Add valid JSON, malformed protocol, atomic-write failure, process lifecycle, and redaction fixtures before production changes.
Read `config/xray.ts`, engine config writing, process/runner modules, and current Xray tests.
Apply only evidence-backed generation/write/lifecycle/redaction corrections while keeping the public config schema compatible.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real xray binary/VPS evidence separately.

technicalNotes: Do not log the full Xray config when it can contain credentials; redact before persistence or display.
